 Ballon d’Or 2026, Lizarazu calls on Mbappé to put the collective back at the center
 The Téléfoot consultant criticized Kylian Mbappé's communication on Sunday before the vote, while urging the captain of the Blues to once again prioritize collective results.

Français (Bénin) 
 Bixente Lizarazu called on Kylian Mbappé to place the collective at the center of his game, on Sunday, November 1, on the set of Téléfoot. The former French international strongly criticized the communication led by the Real Madrid forward before the Ballon d’Or 2026, won by Harry Kane.
 The consultant first recalled that he had defended Mbappé last season and praised his role with the French team. He then stated that the captain of the Blues had “veered” during the Ballon d’Or sequence. Lizarazu criticizes him for being too individualistic and for self-promotion that, according to him, overshadowed his teammates.
 The former French full-back clarified, however, that he did not believe this communication had influenced the vote. His main message concerns the future. He wants to see Mbappé return to the national team with collective values and have a greater impact on the successes of his teams, beyond his personal performance.
 Mbappé finished second in the Ballon d’Or 2026 behind Harry Kane. This position confirms his weight in world football, but also prolongs his wait for the most prestigious individual trophy.
 Lizarazu’s statement is an analysis from a consultant and not a position of the French national team or Real Madrid. It comes less than a week after the verdict and refocuses the debate on Mbappé’s ability to convert his individual performances into collective titles.
